props.name: panels
props.description: The size constraints of the panels.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description:
The initial size of the panels when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the size of the panels.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the splitter. Useful for composition.

props.name: keyboardResizeBy
props.description: The number of pixels to resize the panel by when the keyboard is used.

props.name: nonce
props.description: The nonce for the injected splitter cursor stylesheet.

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Function called when a panel is collapsed.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Function called when a panel is expanded.

props.name: onResize
props.description: Function called when the splitter is resized.

props.name: onResizeEnd
props.description: Function called when the splitter resize ends.

props.name: onResizeStart
props.description: Function called when the splitter resize starts.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the splitter. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`

props.name: registry
props.description:
The splitter registry to use for multi-drag support.
When provided, enables dragging at the intersection of multiple splitters.

props.name: size
props.description: The controlled size data of the panels
